expectations.evidence: States 'MemoryApi is listed as blocked on LMEval' and provides detailed explanation of LMEval as the evaluation platform for prompt quality.
Lists LMApi as project #2 that affects the approach: 'MemoryApi routes all its LLM calls (embeddings, categorization, tagging) through LMApi'.
References 'measurable quality over intuition' principle and recommends rubric-based scoring, deterministic checks, and baselining. States 'resist the urge to just keep tweaking prompts by gut feel'.
Provides a 6-step workflow: (1) Collect failure cases, (2) Define evaluation rubrics in LMEval, (3) Baseline current prompt, (4) Iterate on variants, (5) Test across models, (6) Deploy the winner.
